title: Scalar-cycle normalization of the prescribed left Cech cup
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine relative diagonals, and $G,F$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent] on $Y,X$. Let $T,P$ be the left Cech functors [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-cech-exact] and $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ satisfy the cochain-coordinate predicate IsPicardLeftCechCup of [lem-sc-picard-left-cech-cup-construction]. For the fixed scalar models $A_F,B_G,C_{F,G}$ [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] and their tensor total $D_{F,G}$ [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain], there exist isomorphisms $a_n:H^n(T(F))\cong H^n(D_{F,G})$ and $b_n:H^n(P(F))\cong H^n(C_{F,G})$ for all $n\geq0$, such that the family $a_n^{-1};H^n(\theta_F);b_n$ satisfies IsPicardExternalCupHomology [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-homology-unique]. Explicitly, for scalar-model factor cycles $u,v$ of degrees $p,q$ with $p+q=n$, and any total cycle $z$ whose underlying cochain is the summand inclusion of $u\otimes v$, applying this family to $[z]$ and then the fixed model-to-scalar-cohomology comparison gives externalCup of the scalar classes of $u,v$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], transported along $p+q=n$. The transformation is an input constrained on cochains, not an existential output. The statement gives no direct-sum equivalence or assertion on arbitrary factor homology elements.

proof.text: For each quasi-coherent F, use affine finite intersections and product affine intersections, pullback and tensor quasi-coherence, affine Cech comparison, exact scalar restriction and the fixed resolution comparison to obtain factor homology isomorphisms from the scalar models to the extended scalar Cech complexes and the product isomorphism b. Tensor Kunneth on the extended Cech factors, precomposed with the direct sum of tensor products of factor comparisons, gives e from the direct sum of scalar-model factor homology tensors to tensor Cech homology. All negative terms vanish by extension by zero. Compose the tensor Kunneth comparison with its scalar-model counterpart to obtain the total-homology comparison a in each degree, and take b from the product comparison.

The cochain-coordinate hypothesis identifies theta on each nonnegative pure summand with projection refinements followed by front/back Cech cup. For scalar factor cycles, transport the classes through the factor comparisons and lift to Cech cycles. Tensor Kunneth represents the transported total class by the tensor of these cycles. Refinement/pullback and Cech/sheaf cup compatibility identify its product comparison with externalCup. Scalar-resolution comparison gives exactly the factor classes in IsPicardExternalCupHomology. Degree transports follow p+q=n. Negative terms vanish. Zero coefficients, empty schemes and degree zero obey the same equation.

lean.statement:
theorem picardLeftCechCup_homology
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (θ : picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G ⟶ picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G)
    (hθ : IsPicardLeftCechCup f g G θ)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ (a : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G).obj F).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
          (picardExternalTotal f g F G).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G).obj F).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
          (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      IsPicardExternalCupHomology f g F G (fun n ↦
        (a n).inv ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (θ.app F) (n : ℤ) ≫ (b n).hom)
